newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber market to close early on Dec 24.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber market to close early on Dec 24.

text.p: The Singapore rubber futures market will close early on December 24 with trading to end at 12 noon local time (0400 GMT), an official of the Singapore Commodity Exchange (SICOM) said on Monday.
The market will be closed on Wednesday, Christmas Day, and reopen on Thursday, December 26, he told Reuters.
He said the market would also close early next Tuesday, December 31. Trading will end at 12 noon local time (0400 GMT).
The rubber futures market will be closed on January 1 for the New Year holiday and will reopen on January 2.
